title: Understanding the Dimensions of $$V^T$$
text: The matrix $$V^T$$ is part of the decomposition of X in PCA. It is important to understand the role of $$V^T$$ in this decomposition.

title: Role of $$V^T$$ in PCA
text: In PCA, $$V^T$$ is the matrix of eigenvectors of the covariance matrix of X. It is used to transform the data into the principal component space.

title: Dimensions of $$V^T$$
text: The dimensions of $$V^T$$ are determined by the number of features in the original data matrix X.

title: Determine the Number of Features
text: How many features (columns) does the original matrix X have?

title: Conclusion on Dimensions of $$V^T$$
text: Since the original matrix X has $$3$$ features, the dimensions of $$V^T$$ will be $$3$$ by $$3$$.
